title: Coverage Task Representation + Surface Target Pose Baseline
freeze_policy: This file is loaded and hashed before any task sample, pose, footprint, or coverage output is generated. Acceptance criteria are not changed after observing results.

acceptance_criteria.h2_input_policy: Every emitted task sample must reference a verified H2 canonical geometry record and preserve its geometry hash, unit, frame, transform, topology, normal, and preprocessing provenance.
acceptance_criteria.task_schema: Every sample contains surface point, unit normal, source triangle or point provenance, stand-off, spray direction, TCP position, TCP quaternion, orientation convention, roll policy, footprint parameters, source hashes, configuration hash, and seed.
acceptance_criteria.pose_semantics: TCP local +Z equals the spray direction from TCP toward the surface; TCP position is surface point minus spray direction times declared stand-off; quaternion is xyzw and maps local axes to the declared frame.
acceptance_criteria.roll_semantics: Roll uses the projected global reference-axis policy with an explicit deterministic fallback order and canonical quaternion sign.
acceptance_criteria.footprint_semantics: Footprint is a declared geometric cone projection only; no physical deposition or thickness calibration is claimed.
acceptance_criteria.coverage_semantics: Coverage, uncovered ratio, overlap redundancy, effective coverage, and uniformity are calculated from explicit weighted evaluation samples and declared footprint intersections; all thresholds remain UNRESOLVED.
acceptance_criteria.invalid_geometry: Nonfinite and missing semantic inputs fail closed. Degenerate faces, open boundaries, disconnected components, and isolated regions are reported explicitly and are never silently repaired.
acceptance_criteria.replay: Three same-input same-seed runs have exact identity for task ordering, geometry provenance, points, normals, spray directions, poses, footprint assignments, metric arrays, gate decisions, and semantic output hash.
acceptance_criteria.execution_boundary: No FJT goal, robot motion, Formal R2 mutation, ML training, or path-planning experiment is permitted.
